previous_committed_pushed_phase.commit_message: phase QUALITY-CONTROLS: record derived permissive source review

decision.permission_scope: Future local/private/evidence-only eval-only runner planning for the 7 USER_ADAPTIVE_ONLY scenarios and 21 pair rows, after the gates in eval-only-gates.json pass.

allowed_operations.limits: Artifacts/state only; no source code edits, no eval execution, no external web or AI.
May read only approved user-local/private inputs and redacted evidence refs for the 7 USER_ADAPTIVE_ONLY scenarios; output must be labelled local/private/evidence-only.
Only redacted, non-training, non-common evidence may be copied into repo artifacts; raw private traces stay in the approved user root.
May define expected evidence and no-overclaim wording; must not score outputs or claim quality.

forbidden_operations: external web search or external AI enrichment
actual eval runner execution in this phase
creating common training rows or common datasets
mutating model, checkpoint, target, manifest, locator, or project model registry
copying private/user/session/project-specific rows into common repo training
using EVIDENCE_ONLY rows as eval or training inputs now
claiming semantic quality or semantic readiness
claiming common readiness or strict QUALITY-03 readiness
claiming target promotion or locator update
policy_statement: The 7 USER_ADAPTIVE_ONLY scenarios may be routed only to a later user-local/private/evidence-only eval-only runner after gate approval. This policy does not authorize common training, DPO training, model/checkpoint/locator mutation, target promotion, live-host readiness, semantic quality, quality improvement, token savings, learnability, or strict common QUALITY-03.
